data.current_description:
Starts a simulation and returns the run.

Send `template` to run one of the built-in templates: it supplies the metrics and checks,
and for some templates the flows too, so the request only names the agent and the direction.
Send `plan` to describe a simulation yourself and run it once. Send `planId` to run a plan
you already have.

`template` and `plan` both resolve to a run plan, returned as `simulationRunPlanId`. Add
`saveAsPlan` to keep it, or read it back to see exactly what ran. A plan built from a
template is a snapshot: retuning the template later never changes what that plan runs, which
is what makes a saved one safe to pin in CI.
data.summary_suggestion: Execute a simulation run with template or plan
data.description_suggestion: Starts a simulation run and returns the execution result. Supports three input modes: (1) `template` - runs a built-in template with predefined metrics and checks; (2) `plan` - runs a custom simulation plan once; (3) `planId` - runs a previously saved plan. Both `template` and `plan` resolve to a run plan (returned as `simulationRunPlanId`). Include `saveAsPlan` to persist the plan for future use. Plans created from templates are snapshots and remain unchanged if the template is later modified, making them suitable for CI/CD pinning.
data.reasoning: Original summary 'Run a simulation' is too generic. Description is comprehensive but dense and difficult for AI agents to parse quickly. Improved summary clarifies the multiple input modes. Restructured description with numbered modes and clearer explanation of plan persistence behavior for better AI agent interpretability.

data.current_description:
The call your agent makes at session start. Returns the config JSON for this session, with per-session simulation recognition built in: when the session was originated by a Roark simulation (matched by caller number against the calls Roark has in flight), the STAGING revision is served for that session only, so Autoimprove candidates are tested on your real deployment. Real traffic always resolves to production; any recognition miss degrades to production too.

On the first fetch of an unknown key, pass `defaults` (your baked-in config): the key is registered and the defaults become revision 1. That makes integration a single call.

Cache the response per session; do not fetch per turn.
data.description_suggestion: Fetch the managed agent configuration for a session, with automatic simulation detection and revision selection. When a session originates from a Roark simulation (matched by caller number), the STAGING revision is returned for testing Autoimprove candidates; real traffic and unmatched sessions resolve to PRODUCTION. On first fetch of an unknown key, provide `defaults` (your baked-in config) to register the key and establish revision 1. Returns the resolved configuration JSON. Cache the response per session; do not refetch per turn.
